agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: ReindentFilter._process_identifierlist had an incorrect 'self.wrap_after > 0 and' guard wrapped around the per-identifier newline-insertion condition in the non-VALUES branch. Because wrap_after defaults to 0, this guard suppressed the default identifier-list line splitting entirely, causing 'select foo, bar, baz' to stay on one line instead of splitting into 'select foo,\n  bar,\n  baz'. Removed the erroneous guard so the condition is simply 'if position > (self.wrap_after - self.offset):', matching the equivalent unaffected VALUES-branch logic just above it. Verified via direct sqlparse.format() calls that default reindent, comma_first, and wrap_after all now behave correctly.
